sources.information: Official Sziget homepage identifies the festival and announces its return on 10–14 August 2027. It lists three 2027 five-day passes and their prices.
Official FAQ confirms Sziget Festival 2027 dates of 10–14 August and refers to Sziget 2026. It does not give the 2026 edition dates or historical ticket prices.
Official travel page says Sziget takes place on Óbuda Island in Budapest and gives the address Május 9. park, Budapest, Hungary, 1033.
The official ticket page identifies the 2027 festival, but its partial render contains no ticket listings.

year.reason: The official FAQ refers to Sziget 2026 in information about festival operations, confirming the saved edition year.
The official homepage and FAQ announce Sziget Festival 2027.

dates.reason: The official homepage and FAQ give the festival dates as 10–14 August 2027.

scheduleStatus.reason: The official site says Sziget returns on the confirmed 2027 dates and is selling passes for that edition.

classification.reason: The official site identifies Sziget as a festival and describes its programme as including music; the FAQ also refers to more than 500 artists.

tickets.reason: The official homepage lists these three 2027 pass categories and prices. The 21&Under pass is eligibility-restricted; the 5-day Pass is the lowest-priced unrestricted full-programme pass.
